hindi: सुगम्यता — दिव्यांग समेत सभी के लिए उपयोग-योग्य बनाना
definition: designing products that people with disabilities can actually use
example: Accessibility isn't a feature request; it's the price of shipping.

hindi: कार्यसूची — बैठक के विषयों की क्रमबद्ध सूची
definition: the ordered list of topics a meeting will cover
example: No agenda, no attenda, as the poster says.

hindi: आबंटित करना — धन, लोग या समय तय काम को देना
definition: to assign money, people, or time to a purpose
example: Allocate the budget before the loudest team does it for you.

hindi: सार्वजनिक घोषणा — सबके लिए आधिकारिक सूचना
definition: an official message meant for everyone, read by some
example: Post the holiday list as an announcement, not a reply.

hindi: स्वीकृति देना — औपचारिक हाँ कहना
definition: to formally say yes to something
example: Approved, pending the seven other approvals.

hindi: संदेश संभालकर हटाना — मिटाए बिना इनबॉक्स से बाहर
definition: to file a message out of the inbox without deleting it
example: Archive the thread once the ticket closes.

hindi: संलग्न फ़ाइल — ईमेल के साथ जुड़ी फ़ाइल
definition: the file included with an email, famously easy to forget
example: Resending with the attachment actually attached this time.

hindi: लेखा-परीक्षा — रिकॉर्ड और प्रक्रियाओं की औपचारिक जाँच
definition: a formal inspection of records, finances, or processes
example: The audit found the process we swore we had.

hindi: उपलब्धता — मिलने लायक ख़ाली समय
definition: the open times someone can meet
example: Send your availability and I'll do the calendar Tetris.

hindi: दूर — सीट पर नहीं वाली स्थिति
definition: the presence status meaning not at the desk right now
example: Set yourself to away if you're stepping out for lunch.

hindi: सुविधाएँ — वेतन के अलावा मिलने वाले लाभ, जैसे बीमा
definition: non-salary compensation like insurance, leave, and perks
example: The benefits page says 'competitive'; the dentist bill says otherwise.

hindi: विचार-मंथन करना — बिना रोक-टोक ढेर सारे विचार निकालना
definition: to generate many ideas quickly without judging them yet
example: We brainstormed forty names and shipped with the placeholder.

hindi: बजट — किसी काम या अवधि के लिए तय ख़र्च सीमा
definition: the amount of money allocated for a team, project, or period
example: The budget covers the tool or the contractor, not both.

hindi: कैलेंडर आमंत्रण — बैठक जोड़ने का निमंत्रण
definition: the scheduling request that puts a meeting on people's calendars
example: If there's no calendar invite, the decision didn't happen.

hindi: कैमरा बंद — बिना वीडियो कॉल में शामिल
definition: attending a video call without video enabled
example: I'm camera off today; the haircut needs another day.

hindi: केंद्रीकृत करना — नियंत्रण या काम एक जगह समेटना
definition: to gather control or functions into one place
example: They centralized purchasing, and now pencils take a quarter.

hindi: हालचाल बैठक — प्रगति जानने की छोटी मुलाक़ात
definition: a brief meeting or message to see how things are going
example: Just a quick check-in: any blockers on the migration?

hindi: वचनबद्ध होना — तयशुदा काम देने का ज़िम्मा लेना
definition: to formally promise to deliver something
example: We committed to the date before scoping the work. Classic.

hindi: आना-जाना — घर से दफ़्तर की यात्रा
definition: the trip between home and the office
example: My commute is thirty steps; the office pays in trains.

hindi: एकीकृत करना — बिखरी चीज़ों को मिलाकर एक करना
definition: to merge scattered things into one
example: We consolidated nine dashboards into one nobody opens.

hindi: बंधन — डिज़ाइन को दिशा देने वाली उपयोगी सीमा
definition: a limitation that shapes, and often improves, the design
example: The best feature of the deadline is that it's a constraint.

hindi: सलाहकार — फ़ीस लेकर विशेषज्ञ राय देने वाला बाहरी व्यक्ति
definition: an external expert hired to advise, famously at high rates
example: The consultant's deck recommended everything we said last year.

hindi: अनुबंध — क़ानूनी रूप से बाध्यकारी लिखित समझौता
definition: a legally binding agreement between parties
example: It's in the contract, which nobody read until it mattered.

hindi: अनुबंधित कर्मी — वेतनभोगी नहीं, अनुबंध पर काम करने वाला
definition: a non-employee hired on contract for specific work
example: The contractor ships faster than half the full-time team.

hindi: तालमेल बिठाना — लोगों और कामों को एक सुर में लाना
definition: to organize people and moving parts toward one outcome
example: Someone must coordinate the launch across four teams and two continents.

hindi: क्रिया-आह्वान का संक्षिप्त रूप — क्लिक कराने वाला मुख्य बटन
definition: short for call to action, the click you want most
example: The feedback is always 'make the CTA bigger', every single time.

hindi: गहरे रंग की थीम — काली पृष्ठभूमि वाला रूप
definition: a dark color scheme, easier on eyes and batteries
example: Users demanded dark mode for two years; it shipped and broke every illustration.

hindi: अंतिम तिथि — काम पूरा होने की नियत तारीख़
definition: the date work is due, and the reason it eventually happens
example: The deadline moved twice, so now we call it a window.

hindi: विकेंद्रीकृत करना — निर्णय-अधिकार टीमों में बाँटना
definition: to push decisions and control out to individual teams
example: We decentralized decisions, then centralized them at the first mistake.

hindi: आमंत्रण अस्वीकारना — मीटिंग का न्योता ठुकराना
definition: to reject a meeting invitation, ideally with a reason
example: Feel free to decline if the agenda doesn't need you.

hindi: स्थगित करना — निर्णय या काम बाद के लिए टालना
definition: to postpone a decision or task to later
example: Let's defer that to next quarter, the land of infinite capacity.

hindi: काम सौंपना — ज़िम्मेदारी किसी और को देना
definition: to hand a task and its responsibility to someone else
example: She delegates so well her calendar is a rumor.

hindi: नतीजा देना — वादा किया काम पूरा कर दिखाना
definition: to produce the promised result
example: Miss the party, attend the meeting, deliver the feature.

hindi: गिरावट — आँकड़े में थोड़े समय की कमी
definition: a brief decline in a metric
example: It is a dip, we said, four consecutive months.

hindi: ख़ुद इस्तेमाल करना — अपना उत्पाद ख़ुद बरतकर परखना
definition: to use your own product internally to find its flaws
example: We dogfood the app daily, which explains the bug reports.

hindi: मसौदा बनाना — पहला कच्चा संस्करण लिखना
definition: to write a first rough version
example: Draft the announcement now; we'll argue about adjectives later.

hindi: बीच में निकलना — कॉल ख़त्म होने से पहले छोड़ना
definition: to leave a call before it ends
example: I'll drop off at half past for my hard stop.

hindi: कमरे में हाथी — सबको दिखती पर अनकही समस्या
definition: the obvious problem everyone avoids mentioning
example: The elephant in the room is that nobody uses the app.

hindi: आकलन — काम में लगने वाले समय का अनुमान
definition: a guess about effort, delivered with more precision than confidence
example: My estimate is two weeks, which is an estimate of an estimate.

hindi: विस्तार राजस्व — मौजूदा ग्राहकों के अपग्रेड से बढ़ी कमाई
definition: additional revenue from existing customers upgrading or buying more
example: Expansion revenue saved the quarter, thanks to one customer's hiring spree.

hindi: ख़र्च विवरण — भुगतान-वापसी के लिए ख़र्चों की सूची
definition: an itemized list of work expenses submitted for reimbursement
example: His expense report listed 'team morale' under a bar receipt.

hindi: कंपनी से बाहर का — सोच-समझकर लिखें
definition: outside the company; a flag to watch what you write
example: Careful, there are external folks on this thread.

hindi: संचालन करना — चर्चा या प्रक्रिया को सुचारू चलाना
definition: to guide a meeting or process so it actually goes somewhere
example: She facilitated the workshop so well we finished early. Unheard of.

hindi: अंतिम रूप देना — आख़िरी बदलाव कर पक्का करना
definition: to settle the last details and make something official
example: We finalized the deck; the 'final_v7' filename disagrees.

hindi: अंजाम तक पहुँचाना — कहा हुआ काम पूरा करना
definition: to actually finish what was promised
example: Ideas are free; following through costs a quarter.

hindi: अनुवर्ती कार्रवाई — चर्चा के बाद की अगली कड़ी
definition: a task, message, or meeting that continues something already discussed
example: I owe you a follow-up with the numbers by Friday.

hindi: आगे भेजना — मिला संदेश दूसरों तक पहुँचाना
definition: to send a received message on to someone else
example: Forwarding the client's note; read the third paragraph sitting down.

hindi: वृद्धि दर — किसी आँकड़े के बढ़ने की रफ्तार
definition: the pace at which a metric increases over time
example: The growth rate is impressive; the base is four users.

hindi: कार्यालय-उपरांत मेलजोल — काम के बाद अनौपचारिक जमावड़ा
definition: informal after-work team drinks or socializing
example: Sprint's done; happy hour is at five, attendance suspiciously encouraged.

hindi: बिल्लियाँ हाँकना — बेक़ाबू लोगों में तालमेल बिठाने की मशक़्क़त
definition: trying to coordinate people who refuse to be coordinated
example: Scheduling eight directors for one call is herding cats.

hindi: गृह-कार्यालय — घर में काम की तयशुदा जगह
definition: a dedicated workspace at home
example: The home office doubles as a guest room and triples as storage.

hindi: झटपट मंडली — तुरंत हल के लिए छोटी जुटान
definition: a quick informal gathering to solve something on the spot
example: Two-minute huddle by the whiteboard before the demo?

hindi: परिकल्पना — परखने लायक अनुमान, जिसे प्रयोग जांचता है
definition: a testable guess about what a change will do
example: The hypothesis was written after the results, which helped it a lot.

hindi: विचार-सृजन — जानबूझकर ढेर सारे संभावित समाधान सोचना
definition: the deliberate generation of many possible solutions
example: Ideation rules: no bad ideas until Tuesday, when we cut ninety percent.

hindi: लागू करना — योजना या समाधान को व्यवहार में उतारना
definition: to put a plan, tool, or process into effect
example: We implemented the new process alongside the old one, forever.

hindi: आंतरिक — बाहर से कराने के बजाय कंपनी के भीतर किया गया
definition: done by the company's own staff rather than outsourced
example: We brought design in-house after the third agency invoice.

hindi: बीमा — नुक़सान की भरपाई का अनुबंधित सुरक्षा-कवच
definition: paid protection against specified losses or damages
example: Cyber insurance now costs more than the breach it covers.

hindi: प्रशिक्षु — सीमित अवधि का प्रशिक्षण-कर्मचारी, अक्सर छात्र
definition: a temporary trainee, usually a student, doing real work for a summer
example: The intern's demo worked, which is more than the roadmap could say.

hindi: बीजक/बिल — किए गए काम के भुगतान की माँग का दस्तावेज़
definition: a document requesting payment for goods or services delivered
example: The agency's invoice arrived before their first deliverable did.

hindi: बिलिंग चक्र — बिल भेजने और भुगतान पाने की नियमित अवधि
definition: the recurring rhythm of sending invoices and collecting payment
example: Our invoice cycle is monthly; their payment cycle is theoretical.

hindi: कार्य-केंद्रित सोच का संक्षिप्त रूप — उत्पाद किस काम के लिए चुना जाता है
definition: short for jobs to be done
example: The JTBD interview revealed users hire our app mostly out of habit.

hindi: उत्पाद को पहली बार बाज़ार में उतारना
definition: to release a product to the public for the first time
example: We launch Tuesday, assuming nothing breaks Monday night, which it will.

hindi: विमोचन दिवस — उत्पाद के सार्वजनिक होने का दिन
definition: the day the product finally goes public
example: Launch day plan: press release at nine, hotfix by noon.

hindi: देयता/जोखिम — क़ानूनी या वित्तीय ज़िम्मेदारी
definition: legal or financial responsibility for something that could go wrong
example: Legal calls the old admin panel a liability; we call it Tuesday.

hindi: लाइसेंसिंग — शुल्क लेकर उपयोग की अनुमति देना
definition: granting permission to use software or IP, usually for a fee
example: Our licensing model has four tiers and zero clarity.

hindi: मद — बजट या बिल की एक अलग प्रविष्टि
definition: a single entry in a budget or invoice
example: Snacks are now a line item, so eat responsibly.

hindi: प्रबंधक — टीम के लोगों और नतीजों का ज़िम्मेदार व्यक्ति
definition: the person accountable for a team's output, growth, and bad news delivery
example: A good manager blocks the chaos; a bad one forwards it.

hindi: अनिवार्य करना — ऊपर से आदेश के रूप में लागू करना
definition: to require something by order from above
example: They mandated the tool; adoption remains a suggestion.

hindi: बैठक-थकान — अत्यधिक मीटिंगों से क्लांति
definition: exhaustion from too many meetings in a day or week
example: By Thursday the meeting fatigue is visible on every face.

hindi: बैठक-बोझिल — मीटिंगों से लदा कार्यक्रम
definition: having a schedule dominated by meetings
example: Product is a meeting-heavy job; bring snacks and opinions.

hindi: आंतरिक सूचना-पत्र — निर्णय की लिखित सूचना
definition: a short internal document announcing or explaining a decision
example: The reorg memo raised more questions than it answered.

hindi: मार्गदर्शक — अनुभव से सलाह देने वाला सहयोगी
definition: an experienced colleague who gives guidance, distinct from one who wields influence
example: Her mentor's best advice was to go find a sponsor.

hindi: कार्यवृत्त — बैठक की लिखित कार्यवाही
definition: the written record of what a meeting discussed and decided
example: The minutes say we agreed; my memory disagrees.

hindi: सूचनाएँ बंद करना — बिना छोड़े चुप कराना
definition: to silence a channel or thread's notifications while staying in it
example: I muted the celebrations channel during quarter close.

hindi: मोल-भाव करना — शर्तों पर सौदेबाज़ी करना
definition: to bargain over terms until both sides can live with them
example: Never negotiate the renewal in December; they smell the deadline.

hindi: वेतन और शर्तों पर मोल-भाव
definition: the back-and-forth over salary, equity, and terms before accepting an offer
example: One email of negotiation was worth more than last year's entire raise.

hindi: अगले क़दम — आगे क्या करना है, उसकी सूची
definition: the agreed actions that follow a meeting
example: Let's end with next steps so this hour counted for something.

hindi: कार्येतर समय — दफ़्तरी घंटों से बाहर
definition: time outside the normal working day
example: Deploy freezes exist so off-hours stay off.

hindi: नौकरी का औपचारिक प्रस्ताव — वेतन और शर्तों सहित
definition: a formal proposal of employment with compensation and terms
example: The offer arrived Friday at 5 p.m., expiring Monday at 9.

hindi: वैकल्पिक उपस्थिति — आना अनिवार्य नहीं
definition: invited but not required to attend
example: I was optional, so I optionally did my actual job.

hindi: बाहर से काम कराना — काम बाहरी फर्म को सौंपना
definition: contracting work out to an external company
example: Outsourcing the support queue outsourced the customer goodwill too.

hindi: वादे से ज़्यादा देना — अपेक्षा से बेहतर नतीजा देना
definition: to exceed what was promised
example: Underpromise, overdeliver, and never reveal the formula.

hindi: उपरिव्यय — किराया, प्रशासन जैसे अप्रत्यक्ष स्थायी ख़र्च
definition: ongoing indirect costs like rent and admin that keep the lights on
example: The office is overhead; the espresso machine is morale.

hindi: अतिरिक्त समय — तय घंटों से ज़्यादा काम
definition: work beyond scheduled hours, paid or quietly expected
example: The launch didn't require overtime, just evenings and a Sunday.

hindi: संतान के जन्म या गोद लेने पर मिलने वाला अवकाश
definition: paid leave for a new child, by birth or adoption
example: He returned from parental leave to three reorgs and a new logo.

hindi: पेटेंट — आविष्कार पर सीमित अवधि का एकाधिकार
definition: a legal monopoly on an invention for a limited time
example: We patented the algorithm; a troll patented the idea of algorithms.

hindi: वेतन-व्यवस्था — कर्मचारियों को वेतन देने की प्रणाली
definition: the system and money for paying employees
example: Miss payroll once and the culture deck stops working.

hindi: संदेश ऊपर टाँकना — सबकी नज़र में रखना
definition: to fasten an important message to the top of a channel
example: Pinned the wifi password so people stop asking weekly.

hindi: प्रोडक्ट-मार्केट फ़िट का संक्षिप्त रूप — बाज़ार में उत्पाद की पक्की माँग
definition: short for product-market fit, the milestone every early startup chases
example: The board asked for PMF evidence; we showed a graph and prayed.

hindi: नीति — कंपनी का लिखित नियम
definition: an official company rule about how things must be done
example: There's a policy for laptops and somehow also for plants.

hindi: प्राथमिकता देना — सबसे ज़रूरी काम पहले रखना
definition: to rank work so the most important happens first
example: We prioritized everything, which is how nothing shipped.

hindi: प्राथमिकता — काम का सापेक्ष महत्व-क्रम
definition: an item's rank in the queue; meaningless when everything shares it
example: Everything is priority one, so nothing is.

hindi: पहलक़दम — समस्या आने से पहले क़दम उठाने वाला
definition: acting before being asked or before problems appear
example: Be proactive: file the ticket before the outage.

hindi: परिवीक्षा अवधि — शुरुआती दौर जिसमें नौकरी आसानी से समाप्त हो सकती है
definition: an initial period during which a new hire can be dismissed easily
example: He shipped nothing risky until probation ended.

hindi: क्रय आदेश — ख़रीद की औपचारिक अनुमति का दस्तावेज़
definition: an official document authorizing a purchase from a vendor
example: No purchase order, no license keys; finance is unmoved.

hindi: तिमाही — वित्त वर्ष का तीन महीने का हिस्सा (Q1–Q4)
definition: a three-month business period; companies plan and report by Q1 through Q4
example: The feature slipped a quarter, which is corporate for three months.

hindi: त्रैमासिक — हर तिमाही होने वाला
definition: happening once every quarter
example: The quarterly review is where roadmaps go to be rewritten.

hindi: छोटी कॉल — झटपट, प्रायः बिन तयशुदा बातचीत
definition: a short, often unscheduled voice or video conversation
example: A quick call is rarely quick and never just a call.

hindi: पूर्ण चुप्पी — कोई जवाब नहीं
definition: a total absence of replies from someone expected to respond
example: Two weeks of radio silence since we sent the proposal.

hindi: बैठक की रिकॉर्डिंग — अनुपस्थितों के लिए सहेजा वीडियो
definition: the saved video of a meeting for those who missed it
example: I'll watch the recording, we say, and never do.

hindi: भर्तीकर्ता — उम्मीदवार खोजने और प्रक्रिया चलाने वाला
definition: the person who finds candidates and shepherds them through the hiring process
example: The recruiter said the team was like a family, which explained a lot.

hindi: आवर्ती — कैलेंडर पर तय अंतराल से दोहराने वाला
definition: repeating automatically on the calendar at a set interval
example: The invite was recurring, so nobody remembers why it exists.

hindi: ख़तरे का संकेत — चेतावनी देने वाला लक्षण
definition: a warning sign that something is wrong
example: A vendor with no references is a red flag.

hindi: ख़र्च-वापसी — अपनी जेब से किया ख़र्च कंपनी से वापस मिलना
definition: money paid back for expenses you covered out of pocket
example: The reimbursement arrived two laptops after the conference.

hindi: अस्वीकार करना — प्रस्ताव औपचारिक रूप से ठुकराना
definition: to formally turn something down
example: Finance rejected the expense titled 'vibes'.

hindi: आवश्यकताएँ — उत्पाद को अनिवार्य रूप से क्या करना है
definition: the agreed list of what the product must do
example: The requirements changed twice during this sentence.

hindi: समय बदलना — बैठक नई तारीख़ पर खिसकाना
definition: to move a meeting to a different time
example: Can we reschedule Thursday's sync? My calendar imploded.

hindi: अग्रिम बंधी फ़ीस — सेवाएँ उपलब्ध रखने के लिए नियमित भुगतान
definition: a recurring fee paid to keep a firm's services on call
example: The law firm is on retainer, so go ahead and ask them.

hindi: राजस्व — बिक्री से आई कुल रक़म
definition: money a company earns from selling its products or services
example: Revenue is up; whether profit exists is a separate meeting.

hindi: समीक्षा करना — जाँचकर राय या मंज़ूरी देना
definition: to examine work and give feedback or approval
example: Please review the doc, not just the title.

hindi: उचित आकार देना — घटाने का सौम्य शब्द, प्रायः छँटनी के लिए
definition: to adjust to the 'correct' size; usually a euphemism for cuts
example: The org was right-sized; the work, curiously, was not.

hindi: जोखिम मूल्यांकन — संभावित ख़तरों की पहचान और आकलन
definition: identifying and weighing potential problems before proceeding
example: The risk assessment rated 'intern with prod access' as medium.

hindi: लंबी सेवा के बाद विस्तारित अवकाश
definition: an extended leave, often after years of tenure, to rest or wander
example: Her sabbatical plan was six weeks of not opening the laptop.

hindi: जानबूझकर कम वादा करना — बाद में बढ़कर दिखाने हेतु
definition: to pad an estimate or commit low so you can overdeliver later
example: He sandbags every sprint, then finishes early and looks heroic.

hindi: बुकिंग कड़ी — दूसरों के लिए स्लॉट चुनने का लिंक
definition: a personal booking page others use to pick a meeting slot
example: Sending a scheduling link to a peer reads a little royal.

hindi: स्क्रीन साझा — अपनी स्क्रीन सबको दिखाना
definition: showing your screen to everyone on a call
example: Close your tabs before the screen share, learned everyone, eventually.

hindi: हाथ उठाकर मत — झटपट गिनती
definition: a quick vote taken by raising hands
example: Show of hands: who has actually read the spec?

hindi: बीमारी की छुट्टी
definition: a day off for illness, taken instead of coughing through standup
example: He took a sick day and still shipped a hotfix, which defeats the point.

hindi: अनुमोदन — आगे बढ़ने की औपचारिक स्वीकृति
definition: formal approval that lets work proceed or ship
example: We have sign-off from everyone except the person who matters.

hindi: संदेश कुछ देर टालना — बाद में फिर दिखे
definition: to hide a message until a time when you'll ignore it again
example: I snoozed the invoice reminder to Friday. Twice.

hindi: सत्य-स्रोत — जिस एक जगह के आँकड़े आधिकारिक माने जाएँ
definition: the one system whose numbers are treated as authoritative
example: We have three sources of truth, so technically none.

hindi: विनिर्देश — क्या बनना है उसका लिखित ब्योरा
definition: the written description of exactly what to build
example: The spec says 'intuitive'; the engineers have questions.

hindi: ख़र्च — किसी मद पर जा रही कुल रक़म
definition: the total amount being spent on something, as finance says it
example: Our cloud spend has its own gravity now.

hindi: मानकीकृत करना — सबके लिए एक तय तरीक़ा लागू करना
definition: to make everyone use one agreed way of doing things
example: We standardized on one framework, plus the four legacy ones.

hindi: स्थायी बैठक — कैलेंडर पर हमेशा दोहराती मीटिंग
definition: a meeting that recurs on the calendar indefinitely
example: This standing meeting outlived the project it was created for.

hindi: सांख्यिकीय सार्थकता की बोलचाल — नतीजा असली माने जाने की कसौटी
definition: shorthand for statistically significant
example: Is it stat sig, asked everyone, before the chart finished loading.

hindi: वृत्तिका — किसी ख़ास मद के लिए तय छोटी रक़म
definition: a fixed sum paid for a specific purpose, like learning or wellness
example: The wellness stipend quietly became everyone's unused-gym fund.

hindi: तनाव-परीक्षण करना — चरम हालात में टिकाव जाँचना
definition: to check how something holds up under extreme conditions
example: We stress-tested the budget against 'what if nobody renews'.

hindi: बंद करना — पुरानी सुविधा को आदरपूर्वक विदा करना
definition: to retire a product or feature gracefully
example: We're sunsetting the old dashboard; mourners welcome.

hindi: न्यूनतम अनिवार्य सुविधा — बाज़ार में टिके रहने भर की शर्त
definition: a feature users expect by default; its absence disqualifies you
example: Dark mode went from delighter to table-stakes feature in about two years.

hindi: कार्यभार सँभालना — किसी और का काम या ज़िम्मेदारी लेना
definition: to assume control of work someone else was doing
example: She took over the migration and found the real timeline.

hindi: विषयांतर — मुद्दे से भटकी चर्चा
definition: a side discussion that drifts from the agenda
example: Fascinating tangent; parking lot it and back to the launch.

hindi: टीम-भावना निर्माण — भरोसा बढ़ाने की गतिविधियाँ
definition: activities meant to strengthen trust and rapport within a team
example: Nothing bonds a team like team building nobody asked for.

hindi: अनिश्चित स्वीकृति — शायद आऊँगा वाला जवाब
definition: marked as maybe attending on a calendar invite
example: Twelve invitees, nine tentative: so, a meeting with vibes.

hindi: किसी कंपनी में बिताई गई कुल अवधि
definition: how long someone has been at a company
example: Four years of tenure here counts as elder statesman.

hindi: तृतीय-पक्ष — बाहरी कंपनी द्वारा प्रदत्त
definition: provided by an external company rather than built or done internally
example: The outage was a third-party issue, which soothes no customer.

hindi: अँगूठा निशान — सहमति की मुहर
definition: the minimum unit of agreement, one emoji long
example: A thumbs-up from her counts as formal sign-off.

hindi: समय-प्रहरी — बैठक में घड़ी पर नज़र रखने वाला
definition: the person assigned to watch the clock during a meeting
example: As timekeeper, I'm obligated to say we're ten minutes over.

hindi: समयरेखा — कब क्या होगा, उसकी रूपरेखा
definition: when things will supposedly happen, in order
example: The timeline is aggressive, the word we use instead of fictional.

hindi: समझौता-विनिमय — एक लाभ पाने के लिए दूसरे की कीमत चुकाना
definition: giving up one good thing to get another
example: Every design decision is a tradeoff; today speed beat elegance, again.

hindi: रुझान रेखा — डेटा की दिशा दिखाने वाली रेखा
definition: a line drawn through data points to show direction
example: The trend line points up if you delete March.

hindi: सदस्यता छोड़ना — मेल सूची से नाम हटाना
definition: to remove yourself from a mailing list, hopefully forever
example: I unsubscribed from the newsletter and it came back anyway.

hindi: अत्यावश्यक — तुरंत ध्यान माँगता
definition: needing immediate attention, a label that dulls with every use
example: Everything he sends is marked urgent, so nothing is.

hindi: उपयोगकर्ता प्रतिक्रिया — असली इस्तेमालकर्ताओं की राय और शिकायतें
definition: what actual users say about the product
example: User feedback is unanimous: nobody can find the button we're proudest of.

hindi: विक्रेता — कंपनी को सामान या सेवा बेचने वाली बाहरी फर्म
definition: an external company that sells you goods or services
example: The vendor promised 24/7 support; their inbox disagrees.

hindi: जाँच-परख करना — भरोसे से पहले पृष्ठभूमि की पड़ताल
definition: to check someone or something carefully before trusting it
example: We vet vendors thoroughly now, one breach too late.

hindi: निषेध करना — अधिकार से प्रस्ताव ख़ारिज करना
definition: to block a decision using your authority
example: The CTO vetoed the rewrite; morale and relief in equal parts.

hindi: वीडियो-कॉल थकान — लंबी ऑनलाइन बैठकों की क्लांति
definition: tiredness caused by long hours on video calls
example: Camera off for this one, folks; video-call fatigue is real.

hindi: आभासी पृष्ठभूमि — असल कमरे को ढकने वाला डिजिटल दृश्य
definition: a digital backdrop hiding your real surroundings on video
example: His virtual background flickered, revealing the laundry mountain.

hindi: प्रतीक्षा-कक्ष — मेज़बान की अनुमति तक ठहराव
definition: the holding area before a host admits you to a call
example: Spent five minutes in the waiting room of my own meeting.

hindi: चलते-चलते बैठक — टहलते हुए बातचीत
definition: a meeting held while walking, usually one-on-one
example: He books walking meetings so nobody can share a screen.

hindi: साप्ताहिक बैठक — हफ़्ते की नियमित मीटिंग
definition: a team's regular once-a-week meeting
example: Add it to the weekly's agenda so we actually decide.

hindi: राय देना — चर्चा में अपना मत रखना
definition: to offer an opinion on a discussion
example: Legal wants to weigh in before the blog post goes live.

hindi: दोनों का फ़ायदा — ऐसा नतीजा जिसमें दोनों पक्ष जीतें
definition: an outcome that benefits both sides
example: Remote Fridays were a rare, genuine win-win.

hindi: समेटना — काम धीरे-धीरे बंद करना
definition: to gradually shut something down
example: We're winding down the beta, gently, like a bomb squad.

hindi: मुँह-ज़ुबानी प्रचार — ग्राहकों की आपसी सिफ़ारिश
definition: customers recommending the product to each other, unprompted and unbilled
example: Our best channel is word of mouth, which the dashboard can't take credit for.

hindi: कार्य-सत्र — चर्चा नहीं, साथ बैठकर काम
definition: a meeting for doing the work together rather than discussing it
example: Book a working session; we'll never finish this over comments.

hindi: मिलकर तराशना — समूह-सत्र में विचार सुधारना
definition: to refine an idea together in a group session
example: Let's workshop the name until it means nothing to everyone.

hindi: समेटना — बैठक का समापन और सार
definition: to bring a meeting to a close and summarize outcomes
example: Let's wrap up: three decisions, two action items, one grudge.
